hook: Your coffee crawls up its own cup in space.
title: Coffee That Climbs Up Its Own Cup In Space
description:
On the International Space Station, coffee does not stay at the bottom of a normal cup. A special cup with a sharp inner corner, tested in 2015, lets surface tension pull the coffee along the corner toward the astronaut's mouth. No straw, no pouch.

#Shorts #Space #ISS
comment_prompt: Would you drink space coffee? Yes or no
